secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL
secrets.description: Convex deployment URL (Convex dashboard -> Settings). Required for the app to function; the UI boots without it but all data queries stay empty.

secrets.name: CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT
secrets.description: Convex deployment name, used by the Convex CLI (Convex dashboard -> Settings).

secrets.name: CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY
secrets.description: Convex deploy key for the CLI (Convex dashboard -> Settings -> Deploy Keys). The supplied key is deploy-only.

secrets.name: AUTH_SECRET
secrets.description: Random secret used by @convex-dev/auth for token signing. Must be set on the Convex deployment, not this container.

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key for email notifications. Must be set on the Convex deployment, not this container.
